attempt_selection: parse frozen attempt 1 first; use already-frozen attempt 2 only if attempt 1 is not exact; never combine attempts

invalid_categories.CONTENT_MISSING: fewer than 15 records, missing question, or missing explicit binary judgment
invalid_categories.FORMAT_ONLY: previously invalid under v1 and exactly valid under v2
invalid_categories.OTHER: ambiguous numbering, multiple judgments, duplicate question, unsupported extra content/layout

name: IA-Std-Q15 deterministic parser v2
record_rule: exactly numbered records 1..15, each with a nonempty question ending '?' and exactly one explicit binary Yes or No judgment
scope: one parser-only repair over all 2,000 frozen session records; no regeneration
